definitions: A web browser built upon the Chromium open-source project, which provides the foundational code for rendering web pages and handling browser functionalities.
A browser that utilizes the Chromium rendering engine and architecture, often customized or extended by various developers and companies.
examples: Many popular web browsers are Chromium core browsers.
The new update improved the performance of the Chromium core browser.
Users often choose a Chromium core browser for its speed and compatibility.
